purpose: PR #60 integrated persistence performance acceptance; observed data, never new expected battle fixtures

sourceMappings.description: Original PR #60 adapter merged with main d0ce3bc, before numeric optimization
The measured local commit and published commit have exactly the same Git tree. Original report SHAs are retained; measured local commits are in the evidence bundle.

environment.storage: container overlay; physical device and IOPS undisclosed

unmeasured.piscinaQueueMs: Runtime dispatches only available slots; per-task Piscina queue latency is not exposed by this adapter
unmeasured.tsVersusWasmCpu: Compute contains both TS and WASM; not separately instrumented

summary.interpretation: Worker compute excludes backpressure; totalMs includes formal logs, gzip and canonical SQLite/artifact persistence. Batch elapsed also includes bundle verification/export. RSS is sampled every 100ms; heap/external/arrayBuffers/WASM overlap and must not be summed. Cache verification is separate. Smaller counts are profiling only, never a 1000-match pass.

limits: One baseline host/session; timing is not a guarantee for other CPUs, storage or inputs.
RSS is sampled every 100ms; per-Worker values are per-attempt observations, not OS-enforced total memory isolation.
Quarter summaries group attempts in start order, whereas the acceptance RSS growth uses time windows in the benchmark.
Worker initialization memory is included in derived peaks even for the original adapter, which summarized only warm memory.
The 100-match runs are profiling only; only the actual 1000-match run is eligible for integrated:full-batch.
